Short, choppy charcoal grey hair with straight-cut bangs. Sharp, narrow deep indigo eyes. Appears as a mature teenager with a stoic expression. Slender, compact build. Wears a dark navy and black oversized tactical jacket over a short skirt with black thigh-high stockings. Features a large, dark grey mechanical rigging apparatus with heavy cannons attached to the back.
